tui.session_move_workset.title_sends.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.title_stays.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_sends.role: TUI checkbox label the user must tick before Move is enabled
tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_sends.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_sends.note: {device} verbatim. First person, the user's own statement.

tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_stays.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_stays.note: First person, the user's own statement. {source} is the name of the device that keeps the working files (the conversation's current owner), verbatim; it is NOT necessarily the device the user is typing on.

tui.session_move_workset.confirm.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.cancel.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.loading.role: TUI status line while the preflight runs
tui.session_move_workset.loading.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.cancelled.role: transcript notice after the user pressed Cancel on the working-files card
tui.session_move_workset.cancelled.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
tui.session_move_workset.cancelled.note: Neutral, not an error: the user chose not to move. Nothing was moved.

tui.session_move_workset.confirm_without.role: button on the working-files card when the files could not be listed: moves the conversation and leaves any working files behind
tui.session_move_workset.confirm_without.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm

tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_withou.role: required checkbox before 'Move without the working files'
tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_withou.tone: plain, factual, calm; this is a safety confirmation, not an alarm
tui.session_move_workset.checkbox_withou.note: {source} is the device that keeps the files, verbatim. First person, like the other checkbox.
